title: Permaculture single-slot autosave (v1)
description: Single local JSON slot. One file contains seed + hex states + month + resources. Autosaved on Next, loaded on boot. Corrupt/missing/version-mismatch file MUST NOT crash: loader discards it and starts a fresh seed (see docs/save_spec.md). Spec-only for issue #7; no Godot save/load implementation in this PR.

version.description: Schema version. Integer. v1 only accepts 1. Loader rejects unknown versions and falls back to fresh seed.

seed.description: World-gen seed. Regenerates terrain/heightmap deterministically. Non-negative integer capped at 2^53-1 (9007199254740991) so double-based JSON parsers cannot lose precision and silently change terrain.

biome_id.description: Biome identifier (e.g. sonoran). Free-form string so content packs (issue #6) can add biomes without a schema change.

month_index.description: Total months elapsed since garden creation (turn counter, 0-based). Calendar month = month_index % 12. Autosave increments on every Next press.

resources.description: Player resources snapshot for this turn.

money.description: Current finances. Game over if < 0 at month resolution; saves clamp to >= 0.

water_table.description: Water table level as percent 0..100. Game over if 0 with unmet irrigation demand.

manhours.description: Manhours remaining/banked at save time (unspent hours do not carry full value; see tuning).

hexes.description: Sparse per-hex state overrides. Only hexes with player-placed or mutated state need entries; empty terrain is regenerated from seed. Axial coords (q, r). No duplicate (q, r) pairs: JSON Schema cannot express key-based uniqueness, so loaders MUST reject duplicate coordinates (the reference manual validator in tools/validate_save.py enforces this).

structure_id.description: Structure id from store data (issue #4), or null when none. Examples: house, well, pond, ditch.

plant_id.description: Plant id from content pack (issue #6), or null when none.

growth_stage.description: 0 = seedling/just placed .. 5 = mature. Null/omitted = not applicable.

saved_at.description: Optional ISO-8601 timestamp of when the autosave was written. Informational only; never trusted for logic.
